facades.name: Leidsestraat front
facades.note: Bands from the bottom: the shopfront ribbon and the round-arched shop window; the two low windows over the shop; first storey: two cross windows on the left axes and the pair on the right axis, whose lights stand either side of a carved figure pier about 0.35 m wide (two openings); second storey the same; the round-arched dormer gable window. Axes (crop px / 49.7 from the left end): left windows 1.17 and 2.78, the shop ribbon centre about 2.0 and the gable window 1.9-2.0, the pair 5.3 and 6.4, the arch 5.9: six.
